payload.blocks: Setting plan 261124-1945-run-tests-fgos-leak-check to ready (phase 2, the P1 land-gate fix); it is landed on main as draft.
payload.headline: Stop the plan check counting the regenerated Git census as a footprint clash, so the land-gate fix can go ready?

parts.cause: Every change to scripts/ must regenerate the census (the pre-commit hook refuses a commit whose census does not match, and says a merge needs a regenerated census, not either side's). So any plan that edits scripts/run-tests.mjs must claim it, and four running plans already claim it. The plan check treats a ready plan's overlap with a running one as an error, with no case for a regenerated file.

options.cost: One short backlog item and plan, about half a day.
options.does: A separate small change teaches scripts/plan-contract-check.mjs and the plan contract that a file regenerated on every commit (the census) is not a cross-plan clash; then this plan goes ready.
options.gain: Fixes the cause for every later plan that touches scripts/; the land-gate fix waits hours, not days.
options.harm: Touches the plan contract, a shared rule; one more small item before this one.
options.label: Exempt regenerated census

options.does: Add blockedBy: 261122-2108-delete-dead-node-execution-closure and go ready now.
options.harm: The P1 fix waits for an 11-phase plan that is itself waiting on q-ms5ifcqex6; days of red land gates.
options.label: Wait for the dead-Node plan

options.does: The owner (or a session the owner names) implements phase 2 outside the plan admission path, as was done for the stopgap b4581336d.
options.harm: Bypasses admission and the lead's review; the plan-check gap stays for the next plan.
options.label: Owner commits phase 2 by hand

parts.recommendation: Exempt regenerated census: the clash is never a real conflict (the census is regenerated, never merged), and the same refusal will hit every plan that edits scripts/.

scope.allows: Writing one backlog row and plan for the census exemption, then setting this plan to ready once that lands.
scope.forbids: Changing this plan's phase 2 design, or editing the census by hand.

parts.what: The plan for the land-gate leak fix is written and landed as draft. Flipping it to ready is refused: 'footprint overlaps another active plan: 261124-1945-run-tests-fgos-leak-check and 261122-2108-delete-dead-node-execution-closure'. The only shared path is packages/git/contracts/mutation-census.v1.json.
